title: 🔴 LIVE Break the Spirit of Stagnation and Enter Your Season of Rest
text: Fire of God, fall [snorts] right now. This is midnight fire. This is not a casual prayer. This is not background noise. What is happening right now over your life is a divine interruption. [music] God has pulled you into this moment because your season is shifting. Your stagnation is ending tonight. [music] Your rest is beginning now. Something in the spirit realm is being broken over your life as you engage with this prayer. Do not look away. Do not minimize this window. Do not let distraction pull you out of this moment. You are here by divine appointment. The Holy Ghost summoned you to this place because the chains that have held you in one spot for too long are about to be destroyed by fire. Habach 3:2 says,"Oh Lord, I have heard thy speech and was afraid. Oh Lord, revive thy work in the midst of the years. In the midst of the years, make known. In wrath, remember mercy." The Hebrew word for revive here is kaya, spelled cetyad, meaning to bring back to life, to restore vitality, to cause, to live again. The root of chia carries the force of resurrection power applied to something that has grown still, something that has stopped moving, something that has gone dormant under pressure. Your life has been dormant under pressure. Your gifts have been sitting still under the weight of delay. Your destiny has been quiet when it was supposed to be loud. But right now, the cha of God is moving over your situation. Right now, the revival breath of the most high is entering the dry places of your life. Every area where forward movement stopped, God is reviving it right now in the name of Jesus. Every dream that went silent is receiving the breath of God right now. Every gift that was suppressed is being reactivated by the fire of the Holy Ghost. Every plan God authored over your life before the foundation of the world is being brought back to life in this moment. The stagnation is not your portion. Stagnation was never written in your assignment. What was written is fruitfulness. What was written is advancement. What was written is entering the rest God prepared for you before you were born. You are entering that rest right now in the name of Jesus. Now understand what stagnation is in the spirit. It is not simply a delay. [music] It is a demonic assignment. It is a structured spiritual operation designed to keep you circling the same mountain year after year. To keep you in the wilderness when your promised land is visible, to keep you straining at the oars when God already commanded the wind to stop. The spirit of stagnation operates through assignment. It has a name. It has a commission and it has been dispatched against your life with specific instructions. But tonight, every instruction given to that spirit is canled. Every assignment document written against your progress is shredded by the fire of God. Every demonic mandate to keep your life still is nullified in the name of Jesus. You are not stagnant because God forgot you. You are [music] not stagnant because the promise was false. You are not stagnant because you are disqualified. You are stagnant because an enemy has been working overtime to hold your feet in cement. But tonight the cement is breaking. Tonight the chains are snapping. Tonight the spirit of stagnation is being evicted from every area of your life in the name of Jesus. Psalm 68:1 says, "Let God arise. Let his enemies be scattered. Let them also that hate him flee before him. Right now, God is arising over your situation. As God arises over your life, every demonic force assigned to your stagnation is being scattered. Every evil spirit commissioned to keep your life frozen is fleeing right now. Every wicked assignment against your forward movement is being destroyed by the arising of God in your situation. God is not sitting passively over your case. God is standing up. God is moving on your behalf. God is inserting himself between you and every force that has pinned your life down. You are being released right now. You are being set in motion right now. The God who arose for David is arising for you. The God who scattered Pharaoh's army is scattering every spiritual force that has blocked your advancement. Nothing that has been assigned against you can stand when God arises. Not one principality, not one power, not one ruler of darkness, not one spiritual wickedness in high places. They are all being scattered by the arising of God over your life right now in the name of Jesus. Let the fire of God consume every demonic encampment around your destiny. Let the thunder of heaven shake loose every assignment that has been locked onto your life. Let the blood of Jesus speak against every legal ground the enemy has used to hold you in place. You are free. You are moving. You are entering your season of rest in the name of Jesus. Now hear this. The season of rest God is bringing you into is not passive. Rest in the Hebrew is menua spelled men nonhe. Manua is not simply the absence of activity. Manya is the settled state of someone who has arrived at their appointed [music] place. It is the rest of completion. It is the rest of someone who has won the battle and is now seated in victory. It is the rest entered on the seventh day after creation was finished. Not because God was tired, but because everything was complete. Everything was in its right place. Everything was functioning according to divine design. That is the menu God is bringing you into. Not a rest of exhaustion, not a rest of giving up, not a rest of defeat, but the menu of someone who has broken through every barrier, crossed every threshold, and arrived at the place God ordained. You are arriving at your menu right now. Every war that was keeping you from your rest is ending. Every battle that was draining your strength before you could enter your place of peace is being won right now on your behalf. Jesus is fighting for you. The Lord of Hosts is clearing the path. The armies of heaven are moving ahead of you right now. You are being escorted into your season of Menua in the name of Jesus. Right now, the book you need to take this warfare deeper is Tear Down Satanic Thrones. You can get the Kindle or paperback on Amazon or grab the ebook on our stand store. The link is in the pinned comment of this live stream and also in the video description below. Go get it right now while this fire is still burning in your spirit. Do not let this moment pass. The spirit of stagnation has been enthroned over certain areas of your life. And that book will give you the specific warfare prayers to tear down every throne the enemy has erected. Get it now. Do not wait. The momentum of this prayer is a signal that your breakthrough is imminent and you need the tools to sustain what God is releasing. Now back into the fire. Numbers 11:1 through to chapter 14:45 gives you the picture of a people who should have entered rest but instead circled the wilderness for 40 years. The distance from Egypt to Canaan was 11 days on foot. 11 days. But they spent 40 years covering ground they could have covered in 11 days. What turned 11 days into 40 years was not geography. It was not the terrain. It was not the weather. It was the spirit of unbelief operating through fear, through complaint, through the refusal to take the land God had already given. That same spirit has been working against your life. That same assignment has been stretching what should have been a short journey into a long wandering. But tonight, by the authority of the name of Jesus, that assignment is terminated. Every demonic force that has been stretching your journey is being destroyed right now. Every spirit that has been adding unnecessary years to your process is being evicted from your path. Your 11-day journey is not going to become 40 years. Your season of wandering is ending tonight. Your cananan is right in front of you. Your rest is not another decade away. Your rest is here. Your breakthrough is now. Your season of entering is today in the name of Jesus. You have been standing at the edge of your breakthrough too long. You have been at the border of your promise too long. Something has been turning you back every time you got close. Something has been creating confusion, fear, obstacles, and impossibilities. Every time your foot was about to cross the threshold, that some spirit, [music] that something is a demonic assignment. And tonight, that assignment is being cancelled by fire. Every spirit of the threshold assigned to block your crossing is being destroyed right now. Every demonic gatekeeper stationed at the door of your destiny is being consumed by the fire of the Holy Ghost. Every blocking force, every hindering spirit, every delaying power that has positioned itself between you and your promised season is being scattered by the blood of Jesus. You are crossing over tonight. You are stepping into what God prepared for you. Your foot is on the threshold and nothing is stopping you from entering in the name of Jesus. Isaiah 43:18 and 19 says, "Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing. Now shall it spring forth. Shall ye not know it. I will even make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert." God is speaking directly to your stagnation right now. The former things, the old cycles, the same patterns repeating year after year. God is telling you to stop measuring your future by your past. Stop calculating what God can do based on what you have seen happen. Stop letting the memory of stagnation become the ceiling for your expectation. God is doing a new thing over your life. Not a continuation of the old pattern. Not a slightly improved version of what has been. A completely new thing. A thing that will spring forth suddenly. A thing that will emerge from ground that looked dead. A thing that will appear in the wilderness of your waiting and announce that the season has changed. Right now, every old cycle is being broken over your life. Every repeating pattern of failure, every loop of disappointment, every cycle of almost but not quite is being shattered in the name of Jesus. God is making a way where you could not see a way. God is releasing rivers into the desert places of your life. Every dry area, every barren place, every zone that has produced nothing despite your labor and your prayer and your faith is receiving the rivers of God right now. Water is flowing into your desert right now. Life is coming into your barren places right now. The new thing is springing forth over your life right now in the name of Jesus. Now take this into the warfare. Every spirit of stagnation has a root. It does not simply float in the atmosphere and attach itself randomly. Every spirit of stagnation has a legal ground, an entry point, a doorway through which it gained access to your life and your bloodline. Some stagnation is generational. It entered through the bloodline of your fathers and your mothers. It has been operating in your family for generations, holding every member of your lineage in the same place, limiting every person who carried your name to a certain level and refusing to let them go higher. You have seen it in your family. You have watched it repeat. You have wondered why every person in your lineage seems to hit the same ceiling. That is not coincidence. That is a generational spirit of stagnation operating through a bloodline covenant. But tonight that covenant is being [music] broken. Tonight the legal ground that spirit has used to operate in your bloodline is being destroyed by the blood of Jesus. The blood of Jesus is more powerful than the blood of any ancestral covenant. The blood of Jesus speaks better things than the blood of any generational curse. Right now, the blood of Jesus is being applied to your bloodline. Every generational spirit of stagnation is being evicted from your family line. Every demonic limitation passed down from generation to generation is being cancelled by the cross of Jesus Christ. You are not bound by what [music] bound your parents. You are not limited by what limited your grandparents. You are the generation where the cycle breaks. You are the generation where the bloodline stagnation ends. You are the generation that enters the rest your forefathers never reached. The spirit of stagnation is being uprooted from your bloodline right now in the name of Jesus. Some stagnation entered through words spoken over your life. prophetic curses, evil declarations, the mouth of someone who looked at your destiny and spoke limitation over it. Words like you will never amount to anything. Words like you are just like your father. Words like nothing good ever comes from your family. Words like you are not smart enough, not gifted enough, not worthy enough. Those words were not just sounds. Those words were spiritual assignments. Those words were demonic seeds planted in the soil of your future. And they have been growing in the ground of your life, producing a harvest of stagnation, producing a crop of limitation, producing fruit that looks like delay after delay after delay. But tonight, every word spoken against your destiny is being uprooted. Every evil declaration over your life is being reversed. Every prophetic curse released against your advancement is being broken by the name of Jesus. Every seed of limitation that was planted in your future is being pulled out by the roots. Every harvest of stagnation that grew from those words is being consumed by fire. Your future is not defined by what anyone said over you. Your future is defined by what God declared over you before the foundation of the world. And what God declared was good. What God declared was abundance. What God declared was advancement. What God declared was rest and fruitfulness and overflow. Every contrary declaration is nullified right now in the name of Jesus. Jeremiah 29:11 says, "For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of evil, to give you an expected end." The Hebrew word for peace here is shalom. But shalom is not simply the absence of conflict. Shalom in its fullness means nothing missing, nothing broken, completeness, wholeness, soundness in every dimension of life. God's thoughts toward you are shalom thoughts. God is not thinking thoughts of stagnation over your life. God is not designing a future of limitation and delay for you. God is thinking thoughts of completeness, of wholeness, of every broken thing being restored, of every missing piece being returned, of every dimension of your life coming into soundness and fullness. Right now, every thought of the enemy that has been projected into your mind about your future is being destroyed. Every voice that has been telling you that this is as good as it gets, that this is your lot, that you have gone as far as you can go, that the best years are behind you. Every one of those voices is being silenced by the word of the Lord. God's thoughts toward you are shalom. God's plans for you are wholeness. God's future for you is the expected end, the appointed conclusion, the destiny he designed from before you were born. You are going to reach that appointed end. You are going to arrive at the place God designed. You are going to walk into the fullness of your shalom in the name of Jesus. Now, enter this warfare with full authority. Ephesians 6:12 says, "For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. Your stagnation is not natural. Your delay is not just bad luck. Your inability to move forward despite your effort and your prayer and your sacrifice is not because God has abandoned you. It is because there are organized spiritual forces that have been deployed against your life. Principalities, these are ruling spirits with territorial authority, powers. These are demonic forces with specific operational assignments, rulers of the darkness. These are spirits that govern the dark operations in your sphere of influence. Spiritual wickedness in high places. These are demonic entities that operate from elevated positions, from high places in the spirit realm, from thrones of iniquity that have been established over your life, your family, your territory, your bloodline. But right now, every principality assigned to your stagnation is being dismantled by the fire of God. Every power operating against your forward movement is being destroyed by the name of Jesus. Every ruler of darkness that has been governing the delay in your life is being dethroned right now. Every spiritual wickedness in high places that has been orchestrating the stagnation over your destiny is being brought down by the blood of Jesus. The thrones are falling. The assignments are cancelled. The operations are dismantled. The powers are destroyed. You are free in the name of Jesus. Zechariah 4:7 says, "Who art thou, oh great mountain, before Zerubbable, thou shalt become a plain, and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, grace, grace unto it." There is a great mountain standing before your destiny right now. A mountain of impossibility, a mountain of resistance, a mountain of spiritual opposition that has looked immovable, that has looked permanent, [music] that has made your path forward look blocked and sealed and shut. But God is speaking to that mountain right now. God is asking that mountain who it thinks it is. And in the face of the question of God, every mountain of stagnation in your life is being leveled. Every mountain of impossibility is becoming a plane. Every elevated obstacle that has towered over your progress is being brought low by the word of the Lord. The headstone is coming forth. The capstone is being set in place. The finishing is happening. What looks incomplete is being completed. What looks stuck is being moved. What looks impossible is becoming possible. What looks like an immovable mountain is becoming flat ground under your feet. You are walking over the ruins of the mountain that tried to stop you. You are stepping over the rubble of every obstacle that tried to block your destiny. Grace, grace is being released over your life right now. Unmmerited, unearned, supernatural favor is leveling every mountain before you in the name of Jesus. Now understand the enemy's strategy against rest. The enemy knows that when you enter your season of rest, you become dangerous. When you stop striving and start resting in the finished work of Jesus, your faith operates at its highest level. When you enter Manua, when you arrive at your appointed place, your authority increases, your fruitfulness multiplies, your capacity to receive from God expands. So the enemy fights your rest harder than he fights anything else. He keeps you in striving mode. He keeps you in anxiety mode. He keeps you in the wilderness where you are expending energy circling mountains instead of resting in your promised land. He keeps you exhausted so that your faith is depleted. He keeps you in constant warfare so that you never get to experience the rest that comes after the war. But tonight, that strategy is being exposed and dismantled. Every spirit assigned to keep you in perpetual striving is being destroyed right now. Every demonic force working to exhaust you before you reach your rest is being consumed by fire. Every assignment designed to deplete your faith through endless cycles of unanswered expectation is being cancelled in the name of Jesus. Your rest is not something you have to earn through more striving. Your rest is something Jesus already purchased. Hebrews 4:9 says, "There remainth therefore a rest to the people of God." Your rest remains. It has not been cancelled. It has not expired. It has not been given to someone else. It remains. It is waiting for you. It has your name on it. And tonight you are crossing the threshold into it in the name of Jesus. Hebrews 4:10 says, "For he that has entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works as God did from his." The Greek word for rest here is katapo spelled kappa alpha tao alpha pi alpha epsilon omega meaning to cause to cease to give rest to settle down from labor to bring into a state of settled peace after conflict. Katapo is the rest of someone who has stopped fighting the battle in their own strength and has trusted God to complete what only God can complete. right now. Every area where you have been striving in your own strength to break your own stagnation, every area where you have been pushing and pulling and forcing and manipulating trying to make things happen, God is releasing the catapow over, God is saying, "Stop. Stop striving. Stop forcing. Stop trying to move the mountain with your bare hands. Enter the rest. Trust the God who moves mountains with a word. Trust the God who parts seas with a breath. Trust the God who levels plains before his servants with a declaration. Right [music] now, every spirit of anxious striving that has been driving you to exhaust yourself in pursuit of what only God can give is being evicted from your life right now. The peace of God which passes all understanding is being released into every striving place in your soul. The catapower of God is falling on you right now. The settled rest is entering your spirit. The fight [music] is not yours. The battle belongs to the Lord. You are entering your rest in the name of Jesus. Now take this prayer into the midnight watch. The midnight hour is a warfare hour. It is the hour when Samson carried the gates of Gaza on his shoulders. It is the hour when Paul and Silas sang until the prison shook. It is the hour when God sent the death angel through Egypt and broke 400 years of bondage in one night. It is the hour when Jesus was raised from the dead in the deep darkness before the dawn. You are in a midnight season right now. The darkness feels heavy. The silence feels permanent. The waiting has stretched so long that you have begun to wonder if the dawn will ever come. But the midnight hour is not the hour of defeat. The midnight hour is the hour of divine intervention. The midnight hour is when God moves suddenly. The midnight hour is when what looked impossible becomes inevitable. Right now in this midnight season of your life, God is moving. God is releasing the fire that breaks chains. God is releasing the earthquake that opens prison doors. God is releasing the resurrection power that raises dead things back to life. Your dead dream is being raised. Your dead ministry is being raised. Your dead marriage is being raised. Your dead business is being raised. Your dead finances are being raised. Every dead thing in your life that the enemy celebrated over is being raised by the resurrection power of Jesus Christ in the name of Jesus. The midnight is not your end. The midnight is your turning point. The midnight is where your stagnation ends and your rest begins in the name of Jesus. Now receive this prophetic word. You have been in a Joseph season. You have been in the pit. You have been in the prison. You have been in a place where everything you believed about your destiny seemed to be contradicted by your circumstances. You have been in a place where the dreams God gave you looked like lies. You have been in a place where every door seemed to close. Every opportunity seemed to pass you by. Every person who could have helped you seemed to forget you. Joseph was in the pit. [music] Joseph was in the prison. And then in one day, in one moment, in one encounter with Pharaoh, everything changed. The prison became a palace. The forgotten became the remembered. [music] The delayed became the promoted. The stagnant became the unstoppable. That is what is happening over your life right now. Your Joseph moment is here. Your one-day turnaround is arriving. Your sudden promotion is being released from the throne room of God. Every pit experience in your life has been producing character for the palace. Every prison season has been building authority for your appointed position. Every year of waiting has been adding depth to the anointing you will carry when you step into your rest. You are not behind. You are right on time. You are not forgotten. You are being remembered by the God who remembered Joseph in the dungeon. You are not disqualified. You are being positioned. Your season of rest is your palace and you are walking into it right now in the name of Jesus. Genesis 41:14 says, "Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon, and he shaved himself and changed his raignment and came in unto Pharaoh." The word hastily in the Hebrew is ruts, spelled rash vavadi, meaning to run, to move with speed, to be brought out quickly. When God decides to move you from your place of stagnation into your season of rest, the movement is not slow. The movement is ruts. It is running. It is sudden. It is swift. It is the kind of transition that makes people who watched your struggle say, "Where did that come from?" When God releases the ruts over your life, things that took years to move will shift overnight. Things that looked permanently locked will open in a moment. Things that seem to require decades of more waiting will arrive suddenly without warning, without gradual buildup, without the slow process you had been expecting. Right now, the ruts of God is being released over your situation. The sudden movement is beginning. The swift transition is being activated. Every gear in your destiny that has been grinding slowly is being shifted into divine acceleration. You are being brought out hastily. You are being promoted suddenly. You are being moved from the dungeon to the palace with the speed of God's perfect timing. Right now, every demonic force that has been slowing your progress to a crawl is being destroyed by fire. Every spirit of delay that has been putting friction on every door God opens for you is being consumed by the name of Jesus. The ruts of God is moving over your life and nothing can slow it down in the name of Jesus. Now every altar of stagnation that has been erected over your bloodline is being torn down right now. Every high place where the enemy has been operating to hold your life in one position [music] is being dismantled by the fire of God. Every satanic throne established over your destiny to govern your limitation is being brought down by the blood of Jesus. Every demonic agreement made in the spirit realm to keep your life frozen is being cancelled right now. Every covenant of stagnation, whether entered knowingly or unknowingly, whether made by you or made by those before you in your bloodline, is being broken by the superior covenant of the blood of Jesus. The blood speaks. The blood prevails. The blood cancels every contrary agreement. The blood dismantles every demonic altar. The blood uproots every satanic throne. The blood of Jesus is covering your life right now, your family right now, your bloodline right now, your destiny right now. Everything the enemy has been using as a legal instrument to keep you stagnant is being destroyed by the blood in the name of Jesus. Now, enter this prayer with fire. Every spirit of limitation assigned to your finances is being consumed by fire right now. Every demonic assignment against your economic advancement is being destroyed in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of poverty that has been operating as a stagnation force in your financial life is being evicted right now. Every curse of not enough that has been following your finances from one season to the next is being broken by the blood of Jesus. Every financial ceiling that the enemy has installed over your income, over your business, over your career advancement is being shattered right now. The God who opened the windows of heaven over Elijah is opening the windows of heaven over your finances right now. The God who multiplied the widow's oil is multiplying your resources right now. The God [music] who fed 5,000 from five loaves and two fish is releasing supernatural multiplication into your financial life right now. Every stagnation in your finances is ending tonight. Every place where money has been coming in but never staying. Where income has been flowing but never accumulating. Where you have been working hard but never gaining ground. Every leaking vessel is being sealed by the fire of God. Every devourer assigned to consume your financial increase is being rebuked and destroyed in the name of Jesus. You are entering your season of financial rest. Not the rest of having nothing to do, but the menu of financial completeness, of provision that is more than enough, of resources that match the assignment God has given you in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of stagnation in your health is being destroyed right now by fire. every demonic assignment against your body that has been keeping sickness and weakness and infirmity in one place, refusing to move, refusing to respond to treatment, refusing to yield to prayer is being cancelled in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of infirmity that has planted itself in your physical body and refused to leave is being evicted right now by the fire of the Holy Ghost. The healing virtue of Jesus is moving through your body right now. The same power that raised Lazarus from the dead is moving through your bloodstream right now. Every organ that has been functioning below capacity is being restored to divine design right now. Every system in your body that has been held in stagnation by a demonic assignment is being released into full function right now. You are being healed in the name of Jesus. You are being made whole in the name of Jesus. The stagnation in your health is ending tonight. Your body is entering its season of rest. The rest of a body that is whole, that is strong, that is healed, that is functioning according to the original design of the creator in the name of Jesus. Now receive this fire over your spiritual life because the most dangerous stagnation is the stagnation that happens in your relationship with God. When your prayer life goes dry. When the word stops speaking to you. When worship becomes routine. When your spiritual senses go dull and you stop hearing the voice of God clearly. When you are going through the motions but the fire is gone. When you are attending the service but not experiencing the presence. When you are saying the right words but not feeling the power behind them. That spiritual stagnation is the most dangerous form of stagnation because it affects everything else. It affects your discernment. It affects your faith. It affects your authority in prayer. It affects your ability to hear God's direction for your next steps. Right now, every spirit of spiritual dryness is being destroyed. Every demonic assignment against your prayer life is being cancelled. Every force that has been creating distance between you and the presence of God is being consumed by fire. The fire of the Holy Ghost is falling on your altar right now. The fire that fell on Elijah's sacrifice at Carmel is falling on your spiritual life right now. Every wet wood, every waterlogged altar, every circumstance that looked like it should have made fire impossible, the fire of God is consuming it all. Your spiritual life is being revived. Your hunger for God is being restored. Your prayer life is being reignited. Your worship is being set ablaze. Your hearing is being sharpened. Your spiritual senses are being activated. You are coming back into full spiritual vitality right now in the name of Jesus. The chia of God is moving over your spiritual life. And what was dormant is coming alive. And what was dry is being filled. And what was cold is being set on fire. And what was quiet is beginning to roar. And what was still is beginning to move. And the river of God is flowing through your spirit right now. and you are entering the fullness of your walk with the Holy Ghost in the name of Jesus. And every demonic force that separated you from that fullness is being destroyed. And every wall that the enemy built between you and the presence of God is being torn down. And the veil is being removed. And the eyes of your spirit are being opened. And the ears of your spirit are being unstopped. And you are hearing the voice of God with clarity and precision and every assignment of spiritual deafness and spiritual blindness and spiritual numbness is being destroyed right now in the name of Jesus. And the fullness of the Holy Ghost is flooding every chamber of your spirit and every room of your soul and every corner of your life. and you are walking in the light and power and presence of God like never before starting from this midnight hour in the name of Jesus. Now receive this. Receive this word. Receive this fire. The season of stagnation is over. The season of going around the same mountain is finished. The season of running in place is done. God is moving you forward right now. And no devil in hell has the authority to stop what God has decreed over your life. Every territorial spirit that has been blocking the doorway to your breakthrough is being consumed right now in the name of Jesus. The door is open. The door is open. The door is open and you are walking through it in the name of Jesus. Hebrews 4:9 says, "There remainth therefore a rest to the people of God." The Greek word used here for rest is sabotismos and it does not simply mean sleep or inactivity. Sabatismos means a divine sessation from striving, a holy entering into the finished work of God, a sacred alignment with the rhythm of heaven where your labor is no longer frantic and desperate, but powerful and purposeful and carried by the wind of the spirit. You are entering sabatismos right now. You are entering the rest that God [music] has preserved for your life. The striving is ending. The frantic scrambling is ending. >> [music] >> The anxious running in circles is ending. God is calling you into the rest of a person who knows that the battle belongs to the Lord. Who knows that the outcome has already been decided. Who knows that the victory was won at Calvary and all you are doing is walking in the manifestation of what is already finished. Every spirit of anxious striving that has been driving you past the point of your anointing is being cast out right now in the name of Jesus. Every demonic assignment that has been pushing you to earn what God already gave you by grace is being destroyed. You are entering rest. You are entering peace. You are entering the holy confidence of a child of God who knows that the father has already made provision for everything that concerns your life. Isaiah 26:3 says, "Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee because he trustth in thee." The Hebrew phrase for perfect peace here is shalom. Shalom. a doubling that indicates completeness, totality, the fullness of wholeness in every dimension of your life. God is not offering you partial peace. God is not offering you temporary relief. God is offering you shalom. Shalom, the doubled peace, the layered peace, the peace that covers your mind and your emotions and your body and your circumstances and your future all at once. Right now, every spirit of mental torment is being destroyed. Every demonic assignment against your peace of mind is being cancelled by the blood of Jesus. Every thought that has been spinning in your head at midnight. Every anxious scenario that the enemy has been projecting into your imagination, every fear about tomorrow and next month and next year, it is all being silenced right now in the name of Jesus. Your mind is being stayed on God. Your mind is being anchored in the truth of his word. Your mind is being brought into captivity to the obedience of Christ. Every stronghold of anxiety is being dismantled. Every fortress of worry is being torn down. Every high thing that has been exalting itself against the knowledge of God in your thought life is being cast down right now in the name of Jesus. Shalom. Shalom is your portion. Perfect peace is your inheritance. The doubled peace of God is filling your mind right now. And you are resting in the certainty of his love and his provision and his faithfulness over your life. Psalm 46:10 says, "Be still and know that I am God." The Hebrew word for be still here is rafa. And it carries a meaning that is far more violent and powerful than it sounds in English translation.
